title: InputGroup addons do not focus textarea controls
reasoning: InputGroupAddon presents a text-cursor click target and implements click-to-focus behavior, while the same module exports InputGroupTextarea as a supported group control. The click handler only searches for an input element, so textarea-only input groups silently fail to focus the control when the addon is clicked.
recommendation: Update the addon click handler to focus the grouped control by data-slot or by both input and textarea selectors, for example querying `[data-slot=input-group-control], input, textarea` and focusing the matched HTMLElement. Preserve the existing button-child guard.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked tests were provided for these UI primitives, and there is no included test covering addon click focus behavior for textarea groups.
suggestedRegressionTest: Render InputGroup with InputGroupAddon and InputGroupTextarea, click the addon text, and assert the textarea has focus.
